tips.label: 問天氣
tips.text: How is/was the weather? = What is/was the weather like?

tips.label: 答天氣
tips.text: It is/was + 天氣形容詞，例如 sunny、rainy、windy。

tips.label: 雨雪三句型
tips.text: There is a lot of rain. / We have a lot of rain. / It rains a lot.

tips.label: 單數與過去
tips.text: rain、snow 當名詞不可數；當動詞時，現在用 rains/snows，過去用 rained/snowed。

tips.label: 授與動詞
tips.text: give 人 物 = give 物 to 人；buy 人 物 = buy 物 for 人。

tips.label: 受格與原形
tips.text: 人當受詞用 me/him/her/us/them；did、can、will 後面接原形動詞。

notes.title: 詢問與回答天氣
notes.rule: How + be + the weather ...? / What + be + the weather + like ...?
notes.description: 兩種問法意思相同。How 問法不加 like；What 問法要加 like。現在用 is，過去用 was，因為 weather 是不可數名詞。回答可用 It 或 The weather 加 be 動詞與天氣形容詞。It 在此是表示天氣的虛主詞。
examples: How was the weather yesterday? 昨天天氣如何？
What is the weather like in spring? 春天天氣如何？
It was cold and rainy. 當時寒冷又下雨。

notes.title: 天氣形容詞
notes.rule: It / The weather + be + sunny / rainy / snowy / cloudy / windy / cool ...
notes.description: be 動詞後可用形容詞描述天氣。rain、snow、cloud、wind 等名詞不可直接當成這個句型中的形容詞。形容詞不會隨主詞或時態改變；時態由 be 動詞表示。
examples: It is sunny today. 今天天氣晴朗。
It was windy last night. 昨晚風很大。
The weather is cool in autumn. 秋天天氣涼爽。

notes.title: 雨雪句型一：There be
notes.rule: There + is / was + rain / snow + 地點或時間.
notes.description: rain 和 snow 在此是不可數名詞，不加複數 s，也不加 a/an。現在用 is，過去用 was。可用 heavy 或 a lot of、lots of 修飾雨雪的量。否定將 not 放在 be 後；問句把 be 移到 there 前。
examples: There is a lot of rain in Taipei in spring. 臺北春天雨量很多。
There was heavy snow last night. 昨晚下了大雪。
Was there much rain yesterday? 昨天下了很多雨嗎？

notes.title: 雨雪句型二：We / They have
notes.rule: We / They + have / had + rain / snow + 地點或時間.
notes.description: 以當地居民 We、They 等作主詞，have 表示當地有某種天氣。rain、snow 仍是不可數名詞。過去用 had；否定和問句使用 do/does/did，再接原形 have。
examples: We have a lot of rain in Taipei in spring. 我們在臺北春天雨量很多。
They had heavy snow last winter. 他們那裡去年冬天下了大雪。
We don't have much snow here. 我們這裡雪量不多。

notes.title: 雨雪句型三：It rains / snows
notes.rule: It + rains / snows ... / It + rained / snowed ...
notes.description: rain、snow 在此是動詞，天氣主詞用 It。一般現在式表達習慣時，第三人稱單數動詞加 s；過去式加 ed。否定和問句用 does/did 後，動詞改回原形。a lot 修飾動詞時不加 of；名詞前才用 a lot of。
examples: It rains a lot in Taipei in spring. 臺北春天常下很多雨。
It snowed here yesterday. 這裡昨天下雪了。
It doesn't rain much here. 這裡不常下很多雨。
Did it snow last night? 昨晚下雪了嗎？

notes.title: 授與動詞與兩個受詞
notes.rule: 主詞 + 授與動詞 + 間接受詞（人）+ 直接受詞（物）.
notes.description: give、send、show、lend、tell、buy、make 等動詞可接受人和物兩個受詞。人是間接受詞，物是直接受詞。代名詞位於受詞位置時用 me、you、him、her、it、us、them，不能用 I、he、she、we、they。
examples: He gave Tom a notebook. 他給了 Tom 一本筆記本。
I sent her a postcard. 我寄了一張明信片給她。
Mom bought us some snacks. 媽媽買了一些點心給我們。

notes.title: 授與動詞的 to / for 改寫
notes.rule: 主詞 + 動詞 + 物 + to / for + 人.
notes.description: 把物放在人之前時，以介系詞連接人。give、send、show、write、tell、read、teach、lend 常用 to；buy、make、cook、get 常用 for。這裡是授與句型的說明，不另外出單純背誦介系詞搭配的選擇題。
examples: I sent her a card. = I sent a card to her. 我寄了一張卡片給她。
He bought me a cake. = He bought a cake for me. 他買了一個蛋糕給我。
She showed her pictures to me. 她把她的照片給我看。

notes.title: 物品代名詞與較長的人物受詞
notes.rule: give / send ... + it / them + to + 人；buy / make ... + it / them + for + 人
notes.description: 物品以 it 或 them 代替時，本課採用「物 + to/for + 人」的順序，例如 Give it to me。人的受詞很長時，也宜放到 to/for 後，讓句子更清楚。介系詞後的代名詞仍要用受格。
examples: Please give it to me. 請把它給我。
Her aunt bought them for her. 她阿姨買了那些東西給她。
I sent these books to the five-year-old girl. 我把這些書寄給了那位五歲的女孩。

notes.title: 授與動詞的時態與原形
notes.rule: 過去時間用過去式；does / did / can / will 後接原形動詞。
notes.description: 本課例句常用過去式：give → gave、send → sent、lend → lent、buy → bought、make → made、tell → told。一般現在式第三人稱單數加 s。問句、否定句若已使用 does 或 did，主要動詞改回原形；can、will 後也用原形。
examples: Dad lent me his jacket yesterday. 爸爸昨天把他的夾克借給我。
Did he send you a postcard? 他有寄明信片給你嗎？
She can make us a cake. 她可以做蛋糕給我們。

quiz.question: A: ___ is the weather in Taiwan today? B: It's sunny.
quiz.hint: 詢問天氣用 How is the weather?；What 問法則須加 like。

quiz.question: A: ___ was the weather like yesterday? B: It was windy.
quiz.hint: 題尾已有 like，應使用 What was the weather like?。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather during your trip last winter?
quiz.hint: last winter 表示過去，weather 是不可數名詞，be 動詞用 was。

quiz.question: What ___ the weather like in your town right now?
quiz.hint: right now 詢問目前狀況；weather 視為單數，使用 is。

quiz.question: A: How was the weather yesterday? B: ___ was cloudy.
quiz.hint: 描述天氣用虛主詞 It，搭配 was cloudy。

quiz.question: Look at all those clouds! It is ___ today.
quiz.hint: be 動詞 is 後面用天氣形容詞 cloudy，不能放名詞 cloud。

quiz.question: The wind is very strong. It is ___ outside.
quiz.hint: 描述天氣的 be 動詞後用形容詞 windy；wind 是名詞。

quiz.question: A: How was the weather last Sunday? B: It ___ sunny.
quiz.hint: last Sunday 是過去時間，It 是單數，回答用 was。

quiz.question: What's the weather ___ in autumn here?
quiz.hint: What is the weather like? 中的 like 是介系詞，不能變成 likes、liked 或 liking。

quiz.question: A: How is the weather today? B: ___ rainy.
quiz.hint: 完整回答是 It is rainy，It is 可縮寫成 It's；Its 表示「它的」。

quiz.question: There ___ heavy snow on the mountain last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去；snow 為不可數名詞，因此用 There was。

quiz.question: There is a lot of ___ here in spring.
quiz.hint: a lot of 後接名詞；rain 當雨水解釋時不可數，不加 s。

quiz.question: We ___ a lot of rain here every summer.
quiz.hint: every summer 表示習慣；主詞 We 搭配原形動詞 have。

quiz.question: It often ___ in this town in winter.
quiz.hint: often 表示習慣；主詞 It 為第三人稱單數，動詞 snow 加 s。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot here yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，rain 應改成過去式 rained。

quiz.question: We don't ___ much snow here in winter.
quiz.hint: 否定句 don't 後接原形動詞 have。

quiz.question: It doesn't ___ here in summer.
quiz.hint: doesn't 後接原形動詞 snow，第三人稱單數的變化已由 does 表示。

quiz.question: ___ there heavy rain here last night?
quiz.hint: 此處 rain 是不可數名詞；last night 表示過去，There was 的問句以 Was 開頭。

quiz.question: Did it ___ during your summer vacation?
quiz.hint: 過去式問句已有 Did，後面的動詞必須用原形 rain。

quiz.question: They ___ lots of snow in their town last winter.
quiz.hint: last winter 表示過去，have 的過去式是 had。

quiz.question: There ___ much rain here today; the ground is dry.
quiz.hint: 這是 There be 句型，rain 不可數，現在式否定用 isn't。

quiz.question: Does it ___ a lot in Taiwan in spring?
quiz.hint: 問句使用 Does 後，主要動詞要用原形 rain。

quiz.question: It ___ snow here last night, so the streets stayed clear.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去；snow 在此為動詞，否定要用 didn't 加原形動詞。

quiz.question: There was heavy ___ outside, so we stayed home.
quiz.hint: heavy 是形容詞，後面接不可數名詞 rain；rainy 是形容詞，不能當此處的中心名詞。

quiz.question: We ___ any rain here yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，have 的過去否定句用 didn't have。

quiz.question: A: Is there much snow on the mountain now? B: Yes, there ___.
quiz.hint: 回答 Is there...? 要保留 there be 結構，snow 不可數，因此回答 there is。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot in that town every winter.
quiz.hint: every winter 表示習慣，主詞 It 為第三人稱單數，因此使用 rains。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of rain here every spring.
quiz.hint: There be 句型中，a lot of rain 的中心名詞 rain 不可數，現在式用 is。

quiz.question: I gave ___ a postcard yesterday.
quiz.hint: 授與動詞 give 後的人是受詞，she 要用受格 her；hers 是所有代名詞，herself 是反身代名詞。

quiz.question: Mom bought ___ a new jacket last week.
quiz.hint: buy 加人加物時，人是間接受詞，所以用 I 的受格 me。

quiz.question: The teacher showed ___ a lovely picture.
quiz.hint: show 後接受詞，we 要改成受格 us；our 和 ours 表示所有關係。

quiz.question: Dad lent ___ his snowboard yesterday.
quiz.hint: lend 後接受格 him，表示爸爸把滑雪板借給他；he 是主格，his 表示所有，he's 是 he is 的縮寫。

quiz.question: Please give ___ to me; I need my jacket.
quiz.hint: 此處用受格代名詞 it 代替 my jacket，句型是 give it to me；its 表示所有，it's 是 it is。

quiz.question: I bought some snacks for ___ after school.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 for 後面用受格代名詞 them。

quiz.question: She sent a postcard to ___ last week.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 to 後用受格 him，表示寄給他；he 是主格，his 表示所有，he's 是 he is 的縮寫。

quiz.question: Please show ___ your new gloves.
quiz.hint: show 加人加物，人的位置需用受格 me。

quiz.question: Dad ___ me a jacket yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，授與動詞 give 的過去式是 gave。

quiz.question: My aunt ___ me a postcard last summer.
quiz.hint: last summer 表示過去，send 的過去式是 sent。

quiz.question: Mom ___ us some snacks every Friday.
quiz.hint: every Friday 表示習慣；Mom 是第三人稱單數，buy 要加 s。

quiz.question: Did your brother ___ you his snowboard yesterday?
quiz.hint: 過去式問句已有 Did，授與動詞用原形 lend。

quiz.question: Please ___ me another picture of Taiwan.
quiz.hint: Please 引導的祈使句使用原形動詞 show。

quiz.question: Grandpa ___ me a story last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去，tell 的過去式是 told。

quiz.question: My sister can ___ us a cake.
quiz.hint: 助動詞 can 後接原形動詞 make，後面接人 us 和物 a cake。

quiz.question: Please send ___ to her; these are her postcards.
quiz.hint: these postcards 是複數，send 後用受格 them 代替；採 send them to her 句型。

quiz.question: I didn't ___ him my gloves yesterday.
quiz.hint: 過去否定句使用 didn't 後，lend 要維持原形。

quiz.question: Our teacher ___ us an English story every Monday.
quiz.hint: every Monday 表示習慣；Our teacher 是第三人稱單數，動詞用 reads。

quiz.question: My uncle will ___ me a new snowboard soon.
quiz.hint: will 後接原形動詞 buy；soon 表示不久後。

quiz.question: Did Mom ___ a cake for you yesterday?
quiz.hint: 過去問句已使用 Did，make 要維持原形。

quiz.question: Please give the gloves to ___; my hands are cold.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 to 後需用受格 me；my 需接名詞，mine 表示「我的東西」。

quiz.question: My brother ___ me his jacket last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去，lend 的過去式是 lent。
